name: Cecilia Reyes Keffer
office: San Gabriel Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Cecilia Reyes Keffer is a recently retired teacher and a realtor. She served on the leadership of the local teachers union. While in that role, she took part in a special education task force that proposed creating an ongoing committee to evaluate and support students. She supports using state funds from AB 126 to add more inclusion teachers.
